title: Halloween event pre-registration is open
summary: Pre-registration is now open for our upcoming Halloween event, with more details coming very soon.
description: An upcoming TheySix Halloween event is getting closer, and players can now pre-register for a chance to participate before the full event details are revealed.

body.text: Players can now pre-register for the upcoming Halloween event through the application form. An official Minecraft account is required, as cracked clients will not be supported.
More information about the event will be announced soon, including another notification when the event officially releases. Spam or false applications will be rejected.
